INDIVIDUAL MEDICAL COVER - POLICY WORDING
1. Definitions
In this policy 'the Insurer' means Tausi General Insurance Company Limited and 'the Insured' means the person named in the Policy Schedule.
2. Cover
The Insurer will pay reasonable and customary inpatient and outpatient medical expenses incurred by the Insured during the period of insurance, up to the limits shown in the Policy Schedule.
3. Exclusions
The Insurer shall not be liable for any claim arising from a pre-existing condition, meaning any illness or injury for which the Insured received treatment or advice in the 24 months before the start date, unless declared and accepted in writing.
The Insurer shall not be liable for cosmetic treatment, experimental procedures or treatment outside Kenya unless pre-approved.
4. Claims
The Insured must notify the Insurer of any hospital admission within 14 days of admission and submit original invoices, discharge summary and prescription records.
5. Renewal and termination
This policy is annual. The Insurer may terminate it on 30 days' written notice for non-payment of premium.
